# Introduction

### Syntax

```c
part of banking

import standard math trig;
import git://github.com/ebudai/coollib@v1.2;
import /data/banks.sqlite as banks;

/**
* automatically generated by a table in the above imported database
datatype Bank
{
    var bin => unique whole number;
    var name => text;
    var interest rate => number;
    var cash on hand => money;    
}
*/

constant starting balance = $3,200,776.52; //type deduction
alias amount due = money; //alias anything

var original banks state => [Bank] = copy of banks; //list, all copies explicit
var distressed banks => [bank => amount due]; // lookup table

//module static initialization code
if banks is empty 
{
     banks add ("First Bank", 1.0209, starting balance); 
}
else if banks is not empty 
{
     distressed banks[banks[1]] = starting balance; //1-based list indexing
}

function a bank with starting amount of cash => optional Bank
{
    for each bank in banks
    {        
        if bank cash on hand is starting balance
        {
            return best;
        }
    }
    return nothing;
}

let best bank = banks highest cash on hand; //reactive!
banks add (name = "Second", interest = 1.02, cash on hand = $74);
banks add ("Towne Banke", 1.8, $7,000.50);

if best bank name is "Second" 
{ 
    beep;
}

// checked each time 'best bank' changes
when best bank name is "Road Runner"
{
    beep; beep;
}
```

### Motivation

Tired of all the near-unreadable boilerplate necessary to hook up variables to a user-interface, I set about creating a language which will allow for rapid scripting of game code, while at the same time being so readable the scripter can leave the project for months and pick back up without needing to re-learn the majority of the codebase before being productive again.

### Why use Ronin?

- Worry-free, readable reactive programming without any boilerplate or lambdas everywhere
- Expressive syntax obviates the need for acronyms, underscores, and camel casing
- Painless, straightforward importing of dotnet and native libraries with automatic glue-code generation
- Automated ORM generation for imported databases
- Cross-platform (Win32, Linux, MacOS, Web, iOS, Android, BSD)
- Full-featured built-in capabilities including GUI
